sql: SELECT cl.nom_pessoa, COUNT(hl.seq_licitacao) AS total_vitorias FROM licitacao_homologLicitacao hl JOIN licitacao_credLicitacao cl ON hl.seq_licitacao = cl.seq_licitacao AND hl.ano_referencia = cl.ano_referencia WHERE hl.ano_referencia = 2025 GROUP BY cl.nom_pessoa ORDER BY total_vitorias DESC LIMIT 1;
